summary: Practise supplier due diligence, risk scoring, monitoring and remediation planning. Explore the five-day course and course outline.
lede: Supplier risk management training helps procurement, supplier-risk and risk practitioners assess supplier exposure and coordinate follow-up. Participants practise due diligence and evidence review, score and tier suppliers, and record exposure and control gaps in risk registers and scorecards. They also build remediation trackers with owners and completion evidence, monitor supplier risks, and prepare concise reports to support procurement decisions, using guidance from ISO 31000:2018 and ISO 20400:2017.
audienceIntro: This course suits foundation-level practitioners who screen, assess or monitor supplier exposure and need to document clear follow-up. It is designed for professionals handling supplier onboarding, due diligence, risk reviews or remediation coordination.
audience: Procurement and Supply Chain Compliance Specialist
modules: Supplier Risk Data and Extended Tiers
prerequisites: A basic familiarity with procurement, supplier onboarding or supply-chain processes will help you work through the exercises. Coding is not required; activities use supplier risk records and spreadsheet-based trackers.
